basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the marketplace blueprint for small and mid-size contractors and how regional distributors fit, and plan the pilot.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Launch the pilot in one region on this blueprint?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Launch a first marketplace version to contractors in one region and track repeat orders and distributor contract status.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Is the pilot evidence ready to take into the 2027 budget round?

architect_notes: The 20 weeks are stated; the 6-week Design and 14-week Pilot split is an estimate based on archetype lengths and time to repeat orders.
No Implementation phase: the marketplace is new, so the plan stops at the pilot; the rollout after it is not in these phases.
No Measurement phase: the brief's repeat-order and distributor criteria are tracked inside the Pilot, because 20 weeks leave no separate post-launch stage.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, digital product passports under the Construction Products Regulation. Confirm whether it is in scope.
